name: zuna
description: A private, browser-local PDF narration companion.

scripts.check: python3 -m py_compile backend/kokoro_server.py && node --check frontend/app.js && node --check frontend/browser-kokoro.mjs && node --check frontend/kokoro-worker.mjs && node --check frontend/epub.mjs && node --check frontend/local-cache.mjs && node --check frontend/reader-core.mjs && node --check frontend/kokoro-runtime.mjs && node --check backend/server.mjs && node --check mobile/src/reader-state.mjs && next build
scripts.dev:full: backend/.venv/bin/python backend/kokoro_server.py & KOKORO_PID=$!; trap 'kill $KOKORO_PID' EXIT INT TERM; next dev -p 4173
